gaps.sentence: He walked in as ___ nothing had happened.
It was ___ a boring lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: such (+a) + adjective + noun + that… — emphasis structure.

gaps.sentence: She's been ___ from school three times this term.
gaps.explanation: 'be absent from school' — formal way to say not present.

gaps.sentence: The meeting was put ___ until Thursday.
The garden is ___ than I expected — it's huge!
She ___ the door quietly behind her.
This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

gaps.sentence: The cat cleans ___ after every meal.
gaps.explanation: Reflexive: the cat cleans ITSELF (the object is the same as the subject).
